name: Tabs
description: Switches between views of the same content: a tablist of triggers and one panel per tab. Arrow keys move between tabs and follow the text direction; activation is automatic or manual.

livewire.name: tabs
capabilities: Children: tab, each rendering its trigger and its panel; tabs renders the same children from data
wire:model binds the selected tab's value

react.name: Tabs
capabilities: Children: Tab, each rendering its trigger and its panel; tabs renders the same children from data

vue.name: Tabs
capabilities: Children: Tab, each rendering its trigger and its panel; tabs renders the same children from data

props.name: value
props.description: The selected tab's value. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model. Without it, the first enabled tab is selected.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initially selected tab of uncontrolled tabs.

props.name: tabs
props.description: The tabs as data, rendering the same children as composition: { value, label, icon, count, disabled, content }.

props.name: variant
props.description: Segmented for filters and small view switches, underline under a PageHeader. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: size
props.description: The triggers' size. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lays the tablist out in a row or a column, and picks the arrow keys that move between tabs. Emitted as data-orientation.

props.name: activationMode
props.description: Automatic selects a tab as the arrow keys reach it; manual only moves focus, and Enter or Space selects. Emitted as data-activation-mode.
props.a11y: Use manual when showing a panel is slow, such as a server round trip.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the tablist for assistive technology. Needed when a page has more than one set of tabs.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { list: '…', trigger: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: Holds the tablist and the panels.

parts.name: list
parts.description: The tablist: the track the triggers sit in.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: A tab: role tab, aria-selected while selected, and only the selected one in the Tab order.

parts.name: count
parts.description: A tab's count, such as unread items, at the end of the trigger.

parts.name: content
parts.description: A tab's panel: role tabpanel, labelled by its trigger and hidden while another tab is selected. The spec calls it panel; it keeps Zag's name (D-019).

events.name: value-change
events.description: Another tab was selected, by click or the keyboard. Setting value doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Horizontal tabs: move to the next or previous tab, wrapping, and following the text direction, so in RTL ArrowLeft moves to the next tab. Automatic activation selects it too.
Vertical tabs: move to the next or previous tab, wrapping.
Move to the first or last tab.
Manual activation: selects the focused tab.
From the selected tab, moves into its panel; the other tabs are out of the Tab order.

requirements: role=tablist with role=tab triggers and role=tabpanel panels; the selected trigger sets aria-selected=true and aria-controls its panel.
Each panel is labelled by its trigger with aria-labelledby and is hidden while another tab is selected.
Only the selected tab is in the Tab order (roving tabindex); the panel takes focus next.
Disabled tabs set disabled and aria-disabled and are skipped by the arrow keys.
The tablist sets aria-orientation; the arrow keys follow it, and follow the text direction in RTL.
A tablist on a page with several sets of tabs is named with label.
A count in a trigger is part of its name, so screen readers announce it.
The focus ring shows on the focused trigger; the selected trigger is shown by surface and edge, not by color alone.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire (D-015).

tabs.label: Trade history
tabs.content: Every trade in the last year.
